info.title: Arkon API
info.description: Arkon's public developer API. Guide: docs/api.md. Anonymous requests read published content; a personal access token (Authorization: Bearer) adds the scopes it was given, never more than its user's role allows. Errors: {"error": {"code", "message", "fields"?}}.

servers.description: The site the API is reached at

get.summary: API index: version, resources and scopes

parameters.name: hide_empty
parameters.description: Only terms used by published items.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Parent id, or none for top level.

patch.summary: Rename or move a category (owners and admins)

get.summary: The definition of a form a live page uses
Entries (personal data: read:form_entries and a role that may read them)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Whole words or an email address.

post.summary: Send a submission (validated, stored encrypted, rate limited)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key with the same body returns the first result; with another body it is a 409.

get.summary: Images live pages use (anonymous) or the whole library (read:media)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Title, file name or alt text.

post.summary: Upload an image (the same pipeline as the admin: validated, original kept, WebP sizes)

patch.summary: Change title, alt text, caption or description

delete.summary: Move to the Trash (pages that use it keep working)

post.summary: Bring an image back from the Trash

get.summary: One published menu, by id or location (main)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: published (default, anonymous) or, with read:pages, draft, trash or any.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: edit: the draft state of published items (needs read:pages).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The last segment of the URL path.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One field; - for descending. Default path.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: content and/or seo, comma-separated (single items always include both).

post.summary: Create a page (a draft unless status is published)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key with the same body returns the first result; with another body it is a 409.

get.summary: One page with its rendered content and SEO

patch.summary: Change fields; status published publishes, draft unpublishes

delete.summary: Move to the Trash; force=true deletes an item in the Trash permanently

post.summary: Bring it back from the Trash (as a draft)

get.summary: Arkon's deterministic SEO report (live, or the draft with context=edit)

parameters.description: edit: the draft state of published items (needs read:posts).

parameters.name: category

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag ids or slugs, comma-separated (any of them).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: content and/or seo, comma-separated (single items always include both).

post.summary: Create a post (a draft unless status is published)

parameters.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key with the same body returns the first result; with another body it is a 409.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token (arkon_pat_…). Scopes: read:pages, write:pages, read:posts, write:posts, write:categories, write:tags, read:media, write:media, read:forms, read:form_entries, read:users.

rendered.description: HTML of the main content (without the shared header and footer); image URLs are absolute.

variants.description: Responsive WebP sizes keyed by width.

version.description: The version you read; a newer one is a 409.

PublicBlock.description: Public block format, schema version 1: heading {text, level 1–4}, paragraph {text}, image {media_id, alt, caption}, button {label, href}.

url.description: Live URL; null while its page is not published.

has_unpublished_changes.description: Members: the draft differs from what is live.
